title: What a disappointment. I purchased this as a gift
text: What a disappointment. I purchased this as a gift. What a disappointment. I purchased this as a gift. The reviews here were wonderful. Got a call from the recipient of this blanket to say thank you, but the blanket, after being washed, sheds all over and whatever it is washed with comes out covered in blanket fuzz. Even after several repeat washings it did not get any better. I advised her to throw it away, and apologized. This was not a good experience.

product_metadata.title: Northpoint Printed Raschel Animal Throw, American Bald Eagle
features: High resolution colors bring full image to life for long lasting use
Perfect blanket for outdoor enthusiasts and animal lovers
description: Raschel Throws are extremely warm, comfy, and durable for convenient every day use. They are made to hold high resolution prints and rich colors. Our raschel throws feature engineered life like photos of animals. Choose from deer, horses, a black lab, or an american eagle. Animal lovers and outdoor enthusiasts will truly appreciate this throw.
